rows.note: This is the usual all-purpose choice before 植物 for a plant with fleshy, water-storing parts.

example.english: The succulent on my windowsill is still doing well even though I haven’t watered it for a long time.
example.traditional: 我屋企窗台嗰盆多肉植物，好耐冇淋水都仲生得幾好。

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a succulent plant.

example.english: I put a succulent on the windowsill at home.
example.traditional: 我屋企窗台擺咗盆多肉植物。
